AfroTools/Education Tools/Compare school fees

Education Tools

Compare school fees

Start with a fee quote you have. Compare the annual total, then plan monthly costs and savings.

Start with School Fees Comparator

A practical path

  1. 1

    Compare written fee quotes

    Check the same cost period and list what each quote includes.

    School Fees Comparator →
  2. 2

    Test the monthly budget

    Add living, travel and school costs using amounts you know.

    Private Student Budget Planner →
  3. 3

    Plan the funding gap

    Set a target and timeline based on the remaining cost.

    Education Savings Plan Calculator Africa 2026 →

Tools for this task

School Fees ComparatorCompare two written school-fee quotes privately, check monthly pressure, and review source-labelled public reports when available. Confirm current fees with each school.Open tool → Private Student Budget PlannerPlan user-entered monthly and one-off education costs over an explicit period without unsupported city averages, affordability scores or savings advice.Open tool → Boarding School Full-Cost PlannerBuild a quote-based full-duration plan from explicit per-term, monthly, per-trip, annual and one-time costs without unsupported school-type averages.Open tool → Education Savings Plan Calculator Africa 2026Calculate how much to save for your childOpen tool →

Education Tools

Plan student loan repayment

Estimate repayment from your own terms. Check Kenya HELB separately and test the monthly budget.

Start with Fixed-Rate Student Loan Worksheet

A practical path

  1. 1

    Use your loan terms

    Model a statement-based repayment scenario.

    Fixed-Rate Student Loan Worksheet →
  2. 2

    Check HELB separately

    If relevant, work from your own HELB balance and deduction.

    Kenya HELB Repayment Worksheet →
  3. 3

    Check affordability

    See how the planned payment fits your monthly budget.

    Private Student Budget Planner →

A practical path

    African Scholarship Finder →

    Compare your shortlist

    Put programme evidence and missing checks side by side.
